summary: Polls an HTTP endpoint on a schedule and takes each response as a message.

properties.name: AuthType
properties.description: Authentication type used to call the source endpoint (e.g. ApiKey, Basic, OAuth2, Bearer).

properties.name: ApiKey
properties.description: API key, sent as the ApiKey header with the ApiKey authentication type.

properties.name: LoginUrl
properties.description: URL used to obtain a login token for OAuth2 or Basic auth flows.

properties.name: LoginUsername
properties.description: Username for Basic and Login authentication.

properties.name: LoginPassword
properties.description: Password for Basic and Login authentication, and the token for Bearer: {{connections.NAME.accessToken}} works here.

properties.name: LoginBody
properties.description: Optional custom login request (Login auth type). Put the real username and password in LoginUsername and LoginPassword, then write {{username}} and {{password}} here where they belong, e.g. {"email":"{{username}}","password":"{{password}}"}. This field is not hidden, so never type a secret into it directly. Leave empty to send the default body.

properties.name: LoginTokenPath
properties.description: Optional path to the token in the login response (e.g. token, data.access_token). Empty reads the 'jwt' field.

properties.name: Url
properties.description: The source HTTP endpoint URL to pull data from.

properties.name: Headers
properties.description: Additional HTTP headers as key=value pairs separated by newlines.

properties.name: ClientId
properties.description: OAuth2 client ID.

properties.name: ClientSecret
properties.description: OAuth2 client secret.

properties.name: ContentType
properties.description: Content-Type header sent with the request (e.g. application/json, application/xml).

properties.name: Verb
properties.description: HTTP verb to use when pulling data (e.g. get, post).

properties.name: DefaultRequest
properties.description: Default request body template used when no payload is needed.

properties.name: ArrayPath
properties.description: JSON path to the array element in the response to iterate over (e.g. $.items).

properties.name: TimeoutSeconds
properties.description: Seconds to wait for the endpoint to answer before the run fails. Default 100.

properties.name: NextLinkPath
properties.description: For an API that pages its results: the path to the next page's address in each reply (e.g. next, links.next, @odata.nextLink). Pages are followed until it is empty or missing, on the same server only.

properties.name: PageParameter
properties.description: For an API that numbers its pages: the query parameter that does it (e.g. page). Pages are asked for from PageStart up, until one has no items.

properties.name: PageStart
properties.description: The first page's number, with PageParameter. Default 1.

properties.name: MaxPages
properties.description: The most pages one run reads, with NextLinkPath or PageParameter. Default 20.
